The device tags field cuts its value off at the right edge ('phone-testi'). This is normal for a single-line input that scrolls, but the full tag list isn't visible at a glance.
The 'Open terminals' pink/magenta label sits centered on its own line, out of step with the left-aligned layout, and its color clashes with the rest of the palette.
The 'Save tags' and 'Save protected paths' buttons have low contrast. They look disabled, probably because nothing has changed yet, and are hard to read against the dark background.
The last control at the bottom of the viewport is partly cut off by the fold. It can be reached by scrolling.
